edit.statement: Impeachment by the House of Representatives removes a US president from office.
edit.subject: Impeachment of a US president by the House of Representatives
edit.old_object: no removal from office without conviction by the Senate
edit.original: Impeachment by the House of Representatives does not by itself remove a US president from office; removal requires conviction by the Senate.
